|language=en-AU}} == History == Fractal Analytics was founded in 2000 in Mumbai by Srikanth Velamakanni, Pranay Agrawal, Nirmal Palaparthi, Pradeep Suryanarayan and Ramakrishna Reddy.{{cite web|url=http://www.forbesindia.com/article/work-in-progress/fractal-analytics-indias-secondlargest-analytics-firm/36445/1|title=Fractal Analytics: India's Second-Largest Analytics Firm|date=November 5, 2013|work=[[Forbes India]]|access-date=February 22, 2017|quote=After a painful board-level split in 2007, Fractal Analytics turned things around to become India’s second-largest analytics company and growing}} It later moved to the US in 2005.{{Cite web |last=Nataraj |first=Poornima |date=2022-01-05 |title=Analytics & AI firm Fractal raises $360 million investment, becomes the second unicorn acquired Chicago-based strategy & analytics firm, 4i Inc.{{cite web }} In March 2018, Fractal Analytics acquired behavioural architecture company Final Mile.{{Cite news|url=https://techcrunch.com/2022/01/05/ai-startup-fractal-becomes-unicorn-with-360-million-investment-from-tpg/|title=AI startup Fractal becomes unicorn with $360 million investment from TPG|last=|first=|date=5 January 2022|newspaper=TechCrunch|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}} In February 2026, Fractal Analytics held an [[initial public offering]] aggregating about {{INRConvert|2834|c}}, which was subscribed 2.66 times. Described as the first Indian [[artificial intelligence]] company to go public, its shares were listed on the [[National Stock Exchange of India]] and [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] on 16 February 2026, debuting at a discount to the issue price.{{cite news |title=Fractal Analytics' muted IPO debut signals persistent AI fears in India |work=[[TechCrunch]] |url=https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/16/fractal-analytics-muted-ipo-debut-signals-persistent-ai-fears-in-india/ |date=16 February 2026 |access-date=3 July 2026}}{{cite news |title=Fractal Analytics IPO listing on February 16; grey market GMP hints at discounted debut |work=[[Business Standard]] |url=https://www.business-standard.com/markets/ipo/fractal-analytics-ipo-listing-on-february-16-grey-market-gmp-hints-at-discounted-debut-126021300708_1.html |date=13 February 2026 |access-date=3 July 2026}} ==References== {{reflist}} [[Category:2026 initial public offerings]] [[Category:Analytics companies]] [[Category:Companies established in 2000]] [[Category:Technology companies established in 2000]] [[Category:International information technology consulting firms]] [[Category:Software companies of India]] [[Category:Apax Partners companies]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] {{India-company-stub}}
